\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 249-251 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R255-first-pass-words-from-chapters-249-251}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a jungle and a slipper.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an engine, a toll, a motorway, a fine, a helmet
  \item a seed, a root, a branch; a bunch of flowers, a trunk, a thorn
  \item gas, plastic, cotton, wool, silk
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An engine? (\textbf{o motor}.) A toll? (\textbf{a portagem}.) A motorway? (\textbf{a autoestrada}.) A fine? (\textbf{a multa}.) A helmet? (\textbf{o capacete}.) A seed? (\textbf{a semente}.) A root? (\textbf{a raiz}.) A branch; a bunch of flowers? (\textbf{o ramo}.) A trunk? (\textbf{o tronco}.) A thorn? (\textbf{o espinho}.) Gas? (\textbf{o gás}.) Plastic? (\textbf{o plástico}.) Cotton? (\textbf{o algodão}.) Wool? (\textbf{a lã}.) Silk? (\textbf{a seda}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{o provador}.) A size? (\textbf{o tamanho}.) The change you get back? (\textbf{o troco}.) A receipt? (\textbf{o recibo}.) A queue? (\textbf{a fila}.) Seafood? (\textbf{o marisco}.) A prawn? (\textbf{o camarão}.) Tuna? (\textbf{o atum}.) Salt cod? (\textbf{o bacalhau}.) A sausage? (\textbf{a salsicha}.) A corridor? (\textbf{o corredor}.) A back yard? (\textbf{o quintal}.) The ocean?
